mode: generate with two local reference images
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: visual style master for reusable top-down puzzle-board object sprites.

Input images:
- Image 1 is the desired style reference. Extract its visual language only: simple shapes, dark hand-drawn outlines, restrained flat colors, low detail, crisp silhouettes, playful board-game readability.
- Image 2 is the current implementation and a negative reference. Do not copy its photorealistic textures, glossy 3D rendering, mismatched perspective, or overly detailed assets.

Primary request: create one cohesive object style sheet showing exactly seven isolated game-board objects: one potted tree, one low shrub, one low bookshelf, one upholstered armchair, one long rectangular table, one small round fountain, and one rectangular rug.

Style/medium: clean 2D hand-drawn game illustration; consistent 4-6 px dark charcoal-purple outline; flat muted fills; at most one simple cel-shaded shadow tone per material; slightly imperfect ink edges; friendly mystery-board-game feeling. No photorealism, no oil painting, no 3D render, no glossy materials, no detailed wood grain, no detailed individual leaves.

Camera/composition: consistent elevated top-down view around 70-75 degrees for dimensional objects; fountain and rug may be strict overhead. Arrange all seven objects separately with generous space between them on a plain warm off-white presentation background. Every object must use the same camera, outline weight, simplification level, palette, and shadow direction.

Color palette: muted sage and mint greens, dusty lavender and mauve, warm honey beige, pale blue-gray, charcoal-purple outlines. Medium-light overall value; avoid muddy dark brown and neon saturation.

Object readability:
- Tree: terracotta pot, short visible trunk, five to seven simple rounded leaf clusters.
- Shrub: low compact mint-green cluster, clearly shorter and rounder than tree.
- Bookshelf: low lavender cabinet with three simple shelves and a few pale book blocks.
- Chair: warm beige/mauve armchair with simple back, seat, and two arms.
- Table: long pale honey-wood top, very simple legs, no props.
- Fountain: pale blue-gray circular basin with mint water and one simple center shape.
- Rug: dusty mauve rectangle with a minimal border and four or six large geometric motifs.

Constraints: exactly seven objects, no people, no labels, no text, no UI, no grid lines, no room scene, no floor textures behind individual objects, no cast-shadow rectangles, no clipped objects. This is a style master, not final transparent assets.
